n = int(input())
maxBudget = int(input())
numbers = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]
differences = [-1] * n

evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if numbers[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i != n - 1:
        differences[i] = abs(numbers[i + 1] - numbers[i])
        evenCount = 0
        oddCount = 0

differences = [diff for diff in differences if diff != -1]
differences.sort()

accumulatedCost = 0
totalCuts = 0

for diff in differences:
    accumulatedCost += diff
    if accumulatedCost > maxBudget:
        break
    totalCuts += 1

print(totalCuts)
</translated_code>
